method.dem: AWS Terrarium tiles z12 (SRTM-derived), 37 m/px, 3x3 mean slope

rules.RED: slope >= 30 deg | <= 2 m above a stream and within 60 m | slope >= 20 deg within 60 m of >= 30 deg ground (run-out)
rules.ORANGE: slope 20-30 deg | <= 6 m above a stream and within 200 m (gentle terrain) | slope >= 12 deg within 150 m of >= 30 deg ground

method.village_rule: RED if the village point or >= 10% of its 150 m disc is RED terrain; ORANGE if the point is ORANGE or >= 20% of the disc is RED/ORANGE
method.site_rule: GREEN terrain, slope <= 10 deg, >= 300 m from >= 20 deg slopes, >= 12 m above drainage or >= 250 m from it, contiguous area >= 2 ha (usable parcel capped at 40 ha)
method.land_proxy: OSM landuse / forest / protected-area polygons (proxy; not Bhulekh or forest-department records)
method.population: WorldPop 2020 1 km apportioned equally to OSM buildings in each cell
